title: Add embeddable RAG snippet widgets and docsite playbook
author: Priya Singh
description:
Motivation: ship a compact, embeddable RAG snippet widget for docsite and marketing pages so engineers can try live retrieval examples inline without a full dev environment. This introduces a lightweight JS widget + small wasm indexer shim, an example RAG playbook that authors can copy into docs, and a short authoring guide for safety/telemetry toggles.

What this PR does: adds an examples widget implementation (browser-first, no backend required for demo), docsite pages and a playbook with copy-paste snippets, accessibility and CSP notes, and a small harness that runs in CI smoke tests. Includes telemetry opt-out and example dataset with opt-in indexing.

Checklist:
- [x] widget implementation and build script
- [x] docsite playbook with copyable snippets and screenshots
- [x] accessibility and CSP guidance
- [x] CI smoke test for widget render and basic RAG flow
- [x] minimal wasm indexer + polyfill used only in demo mode

Usage: embed the snippet into any static doc page. The playbook describes how to swap the example index for a private index and how to wire the widget to Hosted/Dedicated/Private endpoints with token guidance.

Notes: the demo index is synthetic and marked clearly. For production, follow the playbook to configure private index sources and RBAC.

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Nice compact approach — can we ensure the widget cannot leak API keys if somebody pastes one into the sample? Suggest adding a note and a runtime validator.
Priya Singh: Good catch — added validator that rejects explicit API keys in demo mode and expanded the authoring guide to call out token handling.
Marina Kovalenko: Accessibility review: widget needs keyboard focus ring and ARIA live region for streaming results.
Priya Singh: Added aria-live and keyboard support; included automated axe-lite checks in CI.
Luis Ortega: CI flaky on e2e run, reran and passed; consider adding a shorter headless smoke step to prevent flakiness.
Priya Singh: Added a fast headless smoke test that runs the widget build and checks render output; left full e2e as optional nightly job.
summary: Embeddable RAG snippet widget + docsite playbook that lets authors drop a compact retrieval demo into docs without backend setup
release_notes: Added an embeddable RAG snippet widget and authoring playbook. Intended for demos and docsite examples only; includes guidance to replace demo index with customer indices for production.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus on security (no accidental key exfiltration), accessibility, and the clarity of the playbook for authors who will swap in private indices.
manual_test_steps: Open docs/authoring/embedded-rag-playbook.md and copy the 'embed' snippet into a static HTML page
Serve the static HTML and verify the widget renders and shows the demo index contents
Toggle telemetry opt-out in the widget and confirm no network calls to telemetry endpoint appear in devtools
